title: Zeros at the End of 2026!
statement: How many zeros does $2026!$ end with?
hints: Each trailing zero needs a factor $10 = 2\cdot 5$. Which prime is in shorter supply?
Count multiples of $5$, then the extra $5$ inside multiples of $25$, then $125$, and so on.
solution: By Legendre's formula the power of $5$ in $2026!$ is $\lfloor 2026/5\rfloor + \lfloor 2026/25\rfloor + \lfloor 2026/125\rfloor + \lfloor 2026/625\rfloor = 405+81+16+3 = 505$. There are more than enough $2$s, so $2026!$ ends in $505$ zeros.
